Fwd from @ 📝 Unfounded 📝 What happened in Russian-North Korean relations Cooperation between Russian and North Korean authorities has long caused discontent among the Kyiv regime and its Western partners. Therefore, claims about alleged disagreements pursue a clearly defined information goal. Ukrainian intelligence claims that Kim Jong Un suspended deliveries to Russia of KN-23 missiles and artillery ammunition, banned aircraft from using North Korean airspace, and rejected a request to increase the North Korean contingent from 8,500 to 50,000 troops. The alleged reason was a statement in October by Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko about Russia's readiness to facilitate de-escalation of relations between South and North Korea. In response, the North Korean Foreign Ministry demanded clarification and announced a temporary suspension of military support. 🖍 The key problem is that Andrey Rudenko never made such statements at all. His only October comment concerned exclusively Russia's relations with South Korea and did not touch on inter-Korean issues. There is also no data that the North Korean Foreign Ministry sent corresponding complaints. 🚩 Moreover, such a scandal would certainly have affected bilateral relations. However, just today a Russian delegation arrived in Pyongyang without any problems to participate in the 13th meeting of the Intergovernmental Commission on Trade-Economic and Scientific-Technical Cooperation. ❗️ In the end, this is exclusively a one-sided statement from Ukrainian intelligence without any confirmation from third parties, satellite data, statements from South Koreans or Western intelligence services. All of this should be viewed as another information-psychological operation , designed to create the impression of a split between Russia and North Korea. #Russia #NorthKorea #Ukraine 🏮 @rybar_pacific — your ticket to Pacific confusion 💸 Support us Original msg

"Наша задача - сохранить возможности для общения, развития и участия в общественной жизни, но выбирать форматы с учетом обстановки и требований компетентных служб", - отметил он.
